purpose: Refine the existing soft bow into a small rounded nod; no new catalogue clip

entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production pixel animation sprite sheet of the original Moru seal. Reference 1 is the EXACT approved character and body volume. Reference 2 is the old bow sheet to REPLACE: its middle poses flatten too much. Create a corrected soft nod, exactly FOUR columns by EIGHT rows, 32 equal square cells on a portrait 2:1 canvas (target1024x2048), row-major timeline. Transparent alpha0 background, no grid lines, no labels, no text. Moru must keep the reference1 round gray dome, ivory cheeks and visible generous belly, paired dark eyes, diamond nose, two whisker bars per cheek, indigo front FLIPPERS and forked LEFT tail with ivory notch. No hands, human arms, new marks or accessories. Every frame uses exactly the same camera, framing and scale. Character width70%cell, standing base at78%cellheight, generous clear margin. IMPORTANT: this is a SUBTLE HEAD NOD, NOT a deep bow or squash. Body height may reduce by no more than FIVE PERCENT at the deepest nod. The gray dome and ivory belly remain full and rounded in EVERY frame. Do not lower the entire dome or pancake the seal. Keep the outer body silhouette nearly unchanged. Let the eyes, nose and cheeks move downward only TWO native logical pixels to suggest the gentle head nod. The fixed flippers stay planted. Frames1-4 still neutral with one paired blink;5-12 tiny anticipation and nod down in small coherent increments;13-16 mild smiling closed eyes at deepest nod with FULL-HEIGHT body;17-24 ease back to identical neutral;25-28 tail tip gives one tiny delayed wiggle;29-32 fully settle. First and last pose EXACTLY identical. Use opaque, crisp square pixel clusters, uniform pixel scale, flat navy #171923, gray #d6d3c9, ivory #fff1d7, indigo #6d73d2 and #50569c. No gradients, blur, shadows, antialias haze or speckles. Tiny precise changes between adjacent frames; preserve face spacing and cheek shape rather than independent redrawing.
entries.status: Retained exploration; body still lost too much volume.

entries.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a production SPRITE SHEET of the original Moru pixel seal shown in the ONE reference image. Treat the reference as an exact model sheet, not inspiration. 32 sequential frames arranged FOUR columns by EIGHT rows of equal SQUARE cells. Portrait 2:1 canvas target1024x2048. True transparent background, no grid, no text or labels. In EVERY one of the32 cells, copy the SAME full-height round BODY OUTLINE from the reference. The body outline, width, height, gray dome, ivory belly area and foot baseline MUST remain the SAME. No squash, no stretch, no flattening and NO deep bow. The reference's full ivory belly must always remain visible. Make a VERY SUBTLE acknowledging nod by animating ONLY the face: eyes/nose/whiskers dip just one or two logical pixels and return, with a paired blink then a small smile. The outer gray dome stays fixed like a model-sheet stencil. Frames1-4 neutral/paired blink;5-10 eyes/nose gently dip1pixel;11-16 dip2pixels and paired smiling eyes;17-24 return facial features to their exact neutral positions;25-28 tiny tail-tip wiggle only;29-32 exact neutral again. Preserve matching eye sizes and spacing, navy diamond nose and two whiskers each side. Two short indigo front flippers stay planted, left indigo forked tail keeps ivory notch. No arms or hands or props. Identical camera, actor scale and framing in every cell; art fits central70%cellwidth, feet at78%cellheight, generous transparent margins. Crisp uniform square pixel blocks with solid opaque edges, flat stone-gray #d6d3c9, ivory #fff1d7, navy #171923, indigo #6d73d2 and muted #50569c. No haze, shadow, glow, texture, gradients or random speckles. First and last frames identical. IMPORTANT: do not lower or flatten the gray dome in middle rows. All32 bodies must have the exact same FULL HEIGHT as the first body.

timing: Anticipation, quicker travel, expressive holds and settling are timed separately for hop, shy, folder-peek and soft-bow. Existing source pixels remain unchanged outside soft-bow.
